none: PAS NLM-B0CFF4: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Probably Arles mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [---]ONSTANT[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLO[RIA EXERCIT]VS. In exergue: CONSS. Diameter: 19mm, Weight: 1.98gms, die axis: 6
